pages.text: In the woods, the light turns gold, then pink, then purple. Olive the owl opens one eye.
The rabbits hop home to their burrow, one, two, three, four.
The fox curls up with her tail over her nose.
The hedgehog rolls into a prickly ball under the leaves.
The deer lie down in the long soft grass.
The squirrel tucks his nut away and snuggles into his nest.
The badgers snuffle back into their sett.
The mice creep into the hollow log, tiny tail by tiny tail.
The bear cub yawns a big, big yawn in his den.
The moon floats up above the trees.
Olive spreads her wings and flies softly through the quiet woods.
"Sleep well, everyone," hoots Olive. "I'll keep watch till morning."
